dedupe_keys.name: convlstm based daily snow water equivalent swe predictions in the drammen river basin

description: The STARS4Water team deposits daily ConvLSTM snow-water-equivalent estimates for Norway's Drammen basin. Its own page lists three public NetCDFs: an ERA5-Land-driven 2018 to 2024 series, a SeNorge-driven 2010 to 2020 series, and a second SeNorge-driven 2018 to 2024 series. Filenames describe 1 km grids; Zenodo labels the deposit CC BY 4.0. A Drammen hydropower or runoff simulation could use the overlapping 2018 to 2024 alternatives to test how meteorological forcing changes seasonal snow storage. The longer SeNorge run supplies historical context, but the file-internal overlap was not checked. The outputs are machine-learning estimates, not independent snow observations. The page does not state SWE units, mask, elevation adjustment or a model-error measure. The files total over 6 GB and were not downloaded, so variable definitions and time-axis continuity remain unverified. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these three grids.
name: ConvLSTM-based Daily Snow Water Equivalent (SWE) Predictions in the Drammen River Basin
notes: G6 item G6-2325. Metadata-only draft. Simulation-use and type tags are reviewer classifications. File contents and software execution were not checked. Unknown maturity does not assert active maintenance.
